assessments.headline: Resinate Douglas — $48,201 account, 62 days quiet, still has no owner

Last-90-day spend is $8,162 against $36,838 the prior period, the steepest fade in the book. It is still Unassigned, so nobody owns the call. Resinate Worcester (Joey, $26,325, 17 days since last on a ~33-day cadence) is healthy — this is a Douglas problem, not a Resinate problem.
assessments.action: Matt: assign Douglas to Joey today. Joey: call the Douglas buyer this week, find out what changed on the bulk orders, and quote the next one.

assessments.action: Joey: call Dracut this week and get the next order dated; if they have slowed for a reason, log it as a note so the team knows.
